❄ What would YOU do if you had to spend an entire winter in Antarctica?
Imagine living for months without sunlight, surrounded by endless ice, extreme cold, and no way to leave. Would you stay for the adventure, the science, or the chance to experience the most remote place on Earth?
🌍 What surprised you the most about life in Antarctica — the self-surgery story, children living at the end of the world, or the frozen world beneath the ice?
👇 Tell us your thoughts in the comments!
